name: Send broken and de-indexed page alerts with Apify to Slack

parameters.content:
## Send broken and de-indexed page alerts with Apify to Slack

### Who's it for
Site owners, SEO consultants and agencies who can't afford a silent 404, a stray `noindex` or a canonical mistake on their money pages.

### How it works
1. Runs every morning at 7:00.
2. Checks your list of URLs with the [URL Status & Indexability Checker](https://apify.com/moha-tah/url-status-checker) Actor. It follows redirects hop by hop with loop detection, and reads meta robots, X-Robots-Tag, the canonical and the Googlebot robots.txt verdict.
3. Posts to Slack **only when something is wrong**:
   - 4xx or 5xx status;
   - DNS or TLS error;
   - redirect loop;
   - `noindex`;
   - robots.txt blocking Googlebot;
   - canonical pointing to another URL.

### How to set up
1. In **Pages to check**, list your URLs, one per line.
2. Add your Apify credential to **Check URLs (Apify)**.
3. Connect Slack and choose the channel.
4. Click **Test workflow**, then activate it.

### Requirements
- An [Apify account](https://console.apify.com/sign-up) (the free plan works) and its API token, saved in n8n as a **Header Auth** credential: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`.
- A Slack credential.
- Cost: $0.0008 per URL checked (50 URLs daily is about $1.20/month).

### How to customize
Change the schedule, send the alert by email instead, or feed the URL list from a Google Sheet or your sitemap.

### 1. Pages to check
One URL per line: home, pricing, top landing pages, key articles.

### 2. Check with Apify
Status, redirects and indexability. Add your Apify Header Auth credential here.

### 3. Alert
Only problems are posted to Slack; silent when everything is fine.
